description: Estimate fees versus impermanent loss. Use this when the user gives a price range or a later price, a holding period, and a fee APR, and wants to know whether fees cover impermanent loss, gas, and exit cost. Pass price_now, holding_days, and fee_apr_percent. Pass price_lower and price_upper for a concentrated range, or omit them for the full-range formula. Optionally pass price_later, capital_usd, gas_usd, and exit_cost_usd. Returns the formula, the fee fraction, the IL fraction, whether fees cover IL and the costs you passed, a plain break-even price line, and break-even prices from a sample. It does not look up gas or recommend a position. Not financial advice.

capital_usd.description: Position size, so gas and exit cost can be turned into a fraction of the position

exit_cost_usd.description: Other exit cost. Not looked up

fee_apr_percent.description: Annualized fee APR in percent, such as the 1-day fee APR from check_pool

gas_usd.description: Gas you expect to pay. Not looked up

holding_days.description: How many days the fee APR is applied

price_later.description: A later price to score. Omit to get break-even prices and the range edges only

price_lower.description: Lower bound of a concentrated range. Omit, with price_upper, for the full-range formula

price_upper.description: Upper bound of a concentrated range

name: estimate_lp
title: Estimate fees versus impermanent loss
